# ScriptArcade

> Arcade-style practice app for ServiceNow scripting interview questions, with interactive code puzzles, a colorful simulator-style output, and instant in-context teaching when you make a mistake.

ScriptArcade turns ServiceNow scripting prep into a mobile-friendly game. Pick a module (GlideRecord, Business Rules, Client Scripts, GlideAjax, Script Includes), drop the right block into the code, and watch a simulated instance respond. Built-in difficulty tiers, weekly badges, streaks, and a daily challenge keep practice consistent.

## Pages

- [Arcade lobby](/): Module list, stats, streak, badges, and the daily challenge.
- [Daily challenge](/daily): One curated puzzle per day for bonus XP and streak protection.
- [GlideRecord puzzles](/practice/gliderecord): Server-side record queries, updates, and best practices.
- [Business Rule puzzles](/practice/business-rules): Before/after rules, current vs previous, abort patterns.
- [Client Script puzzles](/practice/client-scripts): onLoad/onChange/onSubmit logic and DOM-free patterns.
- [GlideAjax puzzles](/practice/glideajax): Async client-to-server calls and script include wiring.
- [Script Include puzzles](/practice/script-includes): Reusable server libraries and client-callable patterns.
